channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Datafolha: Tarcísio tem 50%, contra 30% de Haddad, e poderia vencer em 1º turno em SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads the São Paulo re-election race with 50% of total vote intentions, against Fernando Haddad on 30%, according to Datafolha. The poll indicates that the governor could win in the first round.

item.title: Ao vivo: PoderDataCast discute papel do TSE a 10 dias da eleição
item.description: PoderDataCast airs live on Thursday, Sept. 24, at 6:30 p.m., ten days before the first round, with former TSE minister Edilene Lôbo discussing voting machines, oversight, digital rules, and disinformation. The program will also analyze recent PoderData/Aya polling.

item.title: Brasil 'dá as costas ao futuro' em eleição com candidatos 'desoladores', diz The Economist
item.description: In an editorial on Brazil's 2026 election, The Economist sees little hope in a contest dominated by Lula and the Bolsonaro family. The magazine criticizes entrenched corruption and rising public spending while identifying Mission Party candidate Renan Santos as the outsider closest to what it believes the moment requires.

item.title: Fazenda vê elo entre verba de Dark Horse e estrutura usada pelo crime
item.description: Brazil's Minister of Finance, Dário Durigan, stated that funds used abroad to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro show signs of circulating through the same financial structure used by criminal organizations investigated in Brazil. The statement was made during the third phase of Operation Carbon, highlighting potential links between production funding and criminal activities.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio pede a Fachin suspensão de pedidos de investigação no STF
item.description: The defense team of senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin to suspend ongoing investigations and investigation requests at the STF, arguing that the procedural flow would allow parties to indirectly choose the judge handling the case. The lawyers classify the practice as forum shopping, which they claim constitutes a legal flaw warranting nullity. The request was filed after investigations involving the senator were distributed among different STF justices.

item.title: Eleitores têm até 3 de outubro para baixar e validar e-Título
item.description: The TSE says voters must download and validate the e-Título by October 3, 2026, the day before the first round of Brazil’s general elections. The digital title is valid only when displayed online on a phone or tablet, not as a screenshot, and registration restrictions still prevent voting.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Os depósitos em dinheiro vivo para o guloso do Lulinha
item.description: Papo Antagonista discussed messages on Roberta Luchsinger's phone indicating coordination of cash payments to Lulinha, son of President Lula. Also covered the Provisional Measure banning online sports betting in Brazil.

item.title: Stuhlberger prevê alta de 30% da bolsa com vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Luis Stuhlberger predicts a 30% stock market rally if Flávio Bolsonaro wins, assigning 60% chance of victory to the candidate. He highlights low investor positioning and skepticism about structural reforms.

item.title: Zema sobre Alcolumbre e CPI do Master: "Se não fizer por bem, vai por mal"
item.description: Romeu Zema accused Davi Alcolumbre of blocking the Master Bank inquiry because, he said, he is involved with Daniel Vorcaro and called for a new Senate leader. Novo says it has gathered enough signatures for the inquiry and filed an ethics complaint against Alcolumbre over institutional inaction.

item.title: TSE diz à Procuradoria que chatbots de IA têm apresentado 'comportamento extremamente responsável'
item.description: The TSE informed the General Electoral Prosecutor's Office that generative AI chatbots have demonstrated responsible behavior. The models warn users that they cannot provide electoral recommendations or suggestions, in compliance with current regulations.

item.title: CARTUM: 1432
item.description: The CARTUM 1432 cartoon, published on the eve of the 2026 elections, warns that Brazil's democratic future is at stake again. The text notes the Bolsonarist threat has only retreated, not been defeated, while conservative forces set the pace in Congress and global instability worsens.

item.title: PT prepara “festa do interior” para visita de Lula à Bahia
item.description: President Lula (PT) is preparing a 'countryside celebration' during his visit to Bahia, stopping in Feira de Santana where he will hold a rally and deliver a speech. The campaign aims to mobilize his base in the state's interior with support from mayors and local leaders. The trip is part of the final stretch before the first round of the October 4th elections.

item.title: “Não votem mais em mim”, diz Arruda após decisão do TSE
item.description: Former governor José Roberto Arruda (PSD) will not appeal the TSE’s suspension of his candidacy for governor of the Federal District. Even if his name remains on the ballot, he asked voters not to vote for him.

item.title: Advogados deixam revisão criminal de Bolsonaro após desistência do pedido de liberdade
item.description: Bolsonaro's lawyers withdrew the habeas corpus request in his criminal review case at the Supreme Court after previously asking for his arrest to be suspended. The defense was taken over by Luciana Lauria Lopes, citing a strategic reassessment.

item.title: Ricardo Nunes minimiza fala de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre ida do prefeito a hospital veterinário
item.description: São Paulo mayor Ricardo Nunes downplayed a comment by senator Flávio Bolsonaro suggesting he could be treated at a new municipal veterinary hospital, saying he interpreted it as praise for the quality of animal care services. The remark was made during a campaign livestream with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas while discussing the hospital’s launch in São Paulo’s east zone. Nunes, who serves as Flávio’s electoral officer in São Paulo, emphasized the comment was not meant to be derogatory.

item.title: Delegação brasileira se retira do plenário da ONU durante discurso de Netanyahu
item.description: The Brazilian delegation withdrew from the UN General Assembly plenary during Benjamin Netanyahu's speech, expressing repudiation against Israel's actions. Other countries also left, as Netanyahu accused those present of moral cowardice. Brazil maintains a critical stance toward Israeli military operations in Gaza and supports the two-state solution.

item.title: Em carta a Rubio, 31 congressistas dos EUA acusam governo Trump de tentar interferir na eleição no Brasil
item.description: Thirty U.S. lawmakers wrote to Marco Rubio accusing the Trump administration of using tariffs, sanctions, and diplomatic pressure on Brazilian institutions during the legal proceedings against Jair Bolsonaro. The lawmakers condemned the alleged interference and called on Washington to accept the results of Brazil's October presidential election.

item.title: Marinho chama Messias de “militante do PT” após post sobre “Dark Horse”
item.description: Rogério Marinho called Justice Legal Affairs chief Jorge Messias a “PT activist” after he linked Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro to the Banco Master case and the financing of the film Dark Horse. Marinho accused Messias of using state institutions for the PT, while the attorney general demanded answers about the funds under investigation.

item.title: Associações lançam manifesto contra proibição das bets
item.description: Betting associations launched a manifesto against prohibition, warning of illegal market risks, mass layoffs, and legal uncertainty. They defend regulation under Law 14.790/2023 and call for dialogue instead of electoral disputes.

item.title: Crusoé: A relação de amor e ódio entre Lulinha e Roberta
item.description: The report describes an ambiguous relationship between lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha). She boasted of proximity to the president's son but showed impatience and irritation with him in private conversations.

item.title: Jovem nadador mira cenário nacional e sonha com Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Samuel Caldeira Costa Peron, 13, is a swimmer from Natação São Caetano who competed in the 2026 Brazilian Infant Winter Championship, placing seventh in the 200m breaststroke final. With ambitious goals, he aims for national titles, time improvements, and eventually the Brazilian National Team and Olympic Games.

item.title: Saiba até quando baixar o e-Título para usar o celular na votação
item.description: The TSE announces the deadline to download the e-Título app before the 2026 elections. Voters must download and access the app in advance to use their phone during voting in the first round. Access the e-Título regularly to avoid issues on election day.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro não só ligou, mas implorou que Vorcaro o atendesse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly called and begged Vorcaro to answer, reflecting a moment of political desperation. The incident highlights internal tensions in the 2026 Brazilian electoral landscape.

item.title: Lula endurece discurso sobre bets; Flávio critica regulamentação atual, mas defende aposta esportiva
item.description: Lula hardened his stance on online betting, promising to end sports gambling in the 2026 campaign, after previously stating in 2024 he would test regulations before banning. Flávio Bolsonaro criticizes online casinos but supports keeping sports betting under regulatory control.

item.title: Cury diz que Lula “destruirá” Flávio no 2º turno
item.description: Augusto Cury claimed Lula would defeat Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff and stated he prefers facing him directly, denying any alliance. He criticized both candidates' political models and highlighted his own governance plan. In the polls, Cury has low support while Lula and Flávio lead the vote intentions.

item.title: Lula diz que ‘não cabe representação de miliciano’ no Palácio do Planalto
item.description: President Lula warned against militia representation at Palácio do Planalto during a Rio event, reinforcing campaign linking Flávio Bolsonaro to criminal organizations. Advocated strategic voting to prevent far-right Senate majority.

item.title: Impasse na defesa leva escritório de Ávila a deixar caso Bolsonaro
item.description: The law firm Ávila de Bessa decided to withdraw from defending Jair Bolsonaro after abandoning a preliminary injunction request at the STF aimed at suspending his 27-year and 3-month prison sentence for involvement in a coup plot. The move highlights legal strategy challenges in the ex-president's defense.

item.title: Lula diz que "não cabe representação de miliciano" no Palácio do Planalto
item.description: President Lula stated that the Planalto should not host miliciano representation during a rally in São Gonçalo and emphasized the strategic importance of Senate votes to prevent the right from gaining majority power.

item.title: Lula: maioria de direita no Senado pode "transformar país em um inferno"
item.description: During a campaign event in São Gonçalo, Lula warned supporters about the risk of the right-wing forming a majority in the Senate, saying it would 'turn the country into hell'. He urged votes for Benedita da Silva and Pedro Paulo, stressing the importance of maintaining support for the federal government in the elections.

item.title: Depois de evento com artistas, Lula faz ato em território inimigo no Rio
item.description: Lula held a campaign event in São Gonçalo, a stronghold of Bolsonarismo, alongside Eduardo Paes and Senate candidates, urging voters to avoid a second round and criticizing political opponents like Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Defesa de Arruda diz que cabe recurso contra decisão que barra candidatura
item.description: The defense of José Roberto Arruda claims there is room for an appeal against the TSE decision blocking his candidacy for governor of the Federal District. The TSE rejected the appeal due to convictions for administrative misconduct linked to Operation Pandora's Box. Arruda will hold a press conference at 2:30 PM to address the ruling.

item.title: Nome de Arruda deve aparecer nas urnas, mas votos serão anulados. Entenda
item.description: The TSE blocked Arruda's candidacy, but his name will still appear on the 2026 electronic ballot with votes being nullified. The decision follows the sealing of electoral equipment with the candidate list already finalized.

item.title: A ‘culpa de Zema’ no fracasso de Matheus Simões em Minas, segundo a campanha
item.description: The Mateus Simões (PSD) campaign attributes the difficulties of his Minas Gerais gubernatorial run to the poor performance of Romeu Zema's (Novo) presidential venture and the government's lack of systematic communication on radio and TV. Allies argue that the government's communication strategy, focused on social media and frugality, created a gap between the delivered legacy and electoral recognition, worsening Simões's position in the final stretch of the election.

item.title: Flávio teve nova reserva de voo em jatinho operado por empresa de Vorcaro, mostra e-mail analisado pela PF
item.description: An email analyzed by the Federal Police reveals a new connection between PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and the jet operated by the company Prime You, which had banker Daniel Vorcaro as a partner. The material, extracted from lawyer Willer Tomaz's phone, shows that he booked a flight between Brasília and São Paulo for Flávio on the aircraft, which was not operated as planned. Flávio denies contact with Vorcaro, claiming the plane belonged to Willer and that the trip was a ride between friends.

item.title: Governo Lula cobra explicações da Meta por remoção de vídeo de Porchat sobre o caso Master
item.description: The Lula administration sent a letter to Meta demanding explanations for the suspension of the 'Revelando o Brasil' account, an initiative by Fábio Porchat. The National Secretary of Justice requested urgent information about the removal, with a 48-hour deadline for response.

item.title: Quaest mostra disputa embolada pelas duas vagas ao Senado no Paraná
item.description: A Quaest survey released on September 24 shows a technical tie among six candidates for the two Senate seats in Paraná, within the 3-point margin of error. Voting intentions range from 5% to 14%, with 29% undecided. The survey is registered with the TSE under code PR-02802/2026 and was conducted between September 20 and 23.

item.title: Advogado-geral da União e coordenador de campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro discutem nas redes: 'Se comporta como militante'
item.description: The Attorney General of the Union, Jorge Messias, and Senator Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, traded criticisms on social media after Messias questioned alleged irregularities involving a presidential candidate and the owner of Banco Master. Marinho accused Messias of acting as a PT militant, while Messias challenged the senator to disclose the whereabouts of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign funds.

item.title: Kassio abre divergência e TSE permite que deputado use imagem de Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE, by majority vote, allowed state deputy Lucas Bove to use Jair Bolsonaro's image in campaign materials, reversing a preliminary injunction from Justice Estela Aranha. The case arose after an action by candidate Duda Hidalgo (PT), who challenged the use of the former president's image while his political rights are suspended. The divergence was opened by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques.

item.title: TSE confirma inelegibilidade de Arruda e nega registro de candidatura ao governo do DF
item.description: The TSE rejected José Roberto Arruda's (PSD) candidacy for the Federal District government, deeming him ineligible due to corruption convictions in the Pandora Box case. The decision was made by majority vote in plenary.

item.title: TSE indefere registro de candidatura de Arruda para o governo do Distrito Federal
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) rejected José Roberto Arruda's candidacy for governor of the Federal District, upholding his ineligibility due to convictions related to the Pandora's Box scandal. The decision was unanimous among ministers, determining that Arruda remains unfit to run in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Quando é o dia das eleições presidenciais de 2026?
item.description: The 2026 presidential elections in Brazil will have the first round on October 4 and the second round on October 25. Voting takes place from 8am to 5pm, with time adjustments for different time zones. An ID with photo is mandatory, and priority is given to voters over 80 years old, elderly people, people with disabilities, and pregnant women.

item.title: Chefe de gabinete de Lula discutiu caso Master com advogado de Vorcaro em grupo “Amigos” no WhatsApp
item.description: WhatsApp messages from the 'Amigos' group reveal that Lula's then-chief of staff, Marcola, and Vorcaro's lawyer discussed pressuring the sale of Banco Master to BRB, criticizing the Central Bank president. The messages suggest attempts to influence Central Bank decisions, raising questions about possible political interference in regulatory institutions.

item.title: Quadrilha que vende dados pessoais para golpistas é alvo da polícia em seis estados
item.description: A criminal gang that profited from selling personal data of millions of Brazilians was dismantled in a joint operation across six states. Thirteen individuals were investigated for collecting information through cyber intrusions and selling it to digital fraudsters, generating at least R$ 7 million between 2021 and 2026. Police seized equipment, documents, and blocked luxury assets linked to the scheme.

item.title: Haddad defende agência antifacção ao comentar nova fase da Carbono Oculto
item.description: Fernando Haddad advocated for the creation of an anti-fake news agency during a town hall meeting at Metrópoles, highlighting the Credit Hidden Operation as one of the largest actions against organized crime. He criticized the absence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas from debates and reaffirmed his commitment to cooperation between security forces.

item.title: FOTOS: veja como é avião de Vorcaro usado por Flávio Bolsonaro e Moraes
item.description: A Legacy 650 executive jet, previously managed by a company linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro, was used by both Flávio Bolsonaro and Minister Alexandre de Moraes on separate trips, as reported and confirmed by g1. Flávio traveled with family and friend Willer Tomaz from the US to Brazil in January 2025, while Moraes used the same aircraft in August of that year.

item.title: Quaest no Paraná: Flávio, 40%; Lula, 26%; Cury, 5%; Caiado, 4%; Renan, 4%; e Zema, 2%
item.description: A new Quaest poll in Pará shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading the presidential race with 40% and Lula at 26%. With 13% undecided voters, 77% of respondents have already decided their vote. The survey interviewed 804 voters from September 20 to 23, with a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: No Rio de Janeiro, Lula cita Trump e volta a dizer que 'se ele meter a mão’ na eleição brasileira, ‘vai perder’
item.description: President Lula stated during a rally in Rio de Janeiro that Donald Trump 'will lose' if he interferes in Brazilian elections, reinforcing stance on national sovereignty. The statement revives remarks made at the UN, where he defended non-acceptance of foreign interference in the electoral process. Lula emphasized that Brazilian democracy belongs to Brazilians and rejected foreign proposals deemed invasive.

item.title: “Times que aprendam a viver sem lavagem de dinheiro”, diz Lula contra bets
item.description: President Lula announced during a campaign event his intention to ban sports betting sponsorships in Brazilian football, criticizing clubs' reliance on betting companies and pushing for the SAF model. He argued sports will become more ethical, referencing historical victories without betting, as the government considers tightening online gambling regulations ahead of October elections.

item.title: Governo Lula reduz para R$ 16,1 bilhões congelamento de recursos no Orçamento
item.description: The Lula government announced a reduction in budget freezes, keeping R$ 16.1 billion in funds blocked from ministries to offset revenue shortfalls and new expenditures. The measure aims to balance public accounts amid fiscal challenges.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede a Kassio suspensão da pena de 27 anos e 3 meses
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's lawyers asked Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the 27-year and 3-month sentence imposed for attempting a coup d'état, arguing the trial should have been conducted by the STF Plenary. The request was filed in the criminal review of the conviction.
